mapper.select: SELECT id FROM kb_question WHERE status='READY' AND id IN #{id} ORDER BY id
SELECT from_kp_id FROM kb_kp_edge WHERE to_kp_id=#{id} UNION SELECT to_kp_id FROM kb_kp_edge WHERE from_kp_id=#{id}
SELECT row_version FROM kb_question WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_material_item WHERE question_id=#{questionId}) materialCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_product_question WHERE question_id=#{questionId}) productCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_derivation WHERE parent_question_id=#{questionId}) childCount
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_question SET status=#{status},row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{actor},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question q JOIN kb_question_source qs ON qs.question_id=q.id JOIN kb_source s ON s.id=qs.source_id WHERE q.id=#{id} AND ( (#{kind}='AUTHORED' AND s.source_kind='AUTHORED' AND COALESCE(s.origin_note,'')!='') OR (#{kind}='EXTRACTED' AND qs.match_status='VERIFIED' AND qs.matched_stem_hash=q.stem_hash AND (COALESCE(qs.question_no,'')!='' OR qs.page_from IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_source_asset sa JOIN kb_asset a ON a.asset_id=sa.asset_id WHERE sa.source_id=s.id AND a.status='READY') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_asset a WHERE a.asset_id=qs.evidence_asset_id AND a.status='READY'))))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_kp qk JOIN kb_question q ON q.id=qk.question_id WHERE q.id=#{id} AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM kb_kp k JOIN kb_kp_outline ko ON ko.kp_id=k.id JOIN kb_outline o ON o.id=ko.outline_id JOIN kb_outline_node n ON n.outline_id=o.id JOIN kb_outline_node_kp nk ON nk.node_id=n.id AND nk.kp_id=k.id WHERE k.id=qk.kp_id AND k.subject=q.subject AND o.subject=q.subject AND o.catalog_kind='TEXTBOOK' AND o.status='CONFIRMED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_asset qa LEFT JOIN kb_asset a ON a.asset_id=qa.asset_id WHERE qa.question_id=#{id} AND (a.asset_id IS NULL OR a.status!='READY')
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_question SET status='DRAFT',row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{actor},update_time=NOW() WHERE status='READY' AND id IN #{id}
mapper.sql: kb_question.status='READY' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(#{approvalJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS( question_id BIGINT PATH '$.questionId' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, row_version BIGINT PATH '$.rowVersion' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, facts JSON PATH '$.facts' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR )) a WHERE a.question_id=kb_question.id AND a.row_version=kb_question.row_version AND JSON_LENGTH(a.facts)=(1 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_kp c WHERE c.question_id=kb_question.id) + (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ko.outline_id) FROM kb_question_kp c JOIN kb_kp_outline ko ON ko.kp_id=c.kp_id WHERE c.question_id=kb_question.id) + (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT nk.kp_id,nk.node_id) FROM kb_question_kp c JOIN kb_outline_node_kp nk ON nk.kp_id=c.kp_id WHERE c.question_id=kb_question.id) + (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.source_id) FROM kb_question_source c WHERE c.question_id=kb_question.id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_source c WHERE c.question_id=kb_question.id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_asset c WHERE c.question_id=kb_question.id) + (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.source_id,sa.asset_id,sa.role) FROM kb_question_source c JOIN kb_source_asset sa ON sa.source_id=c.source_id WHERE c.question_id=kb_question.id) + (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.evidence_asset_id) FROM kb_question_source c WHERE c.question_id=kb_question.id AND c.evidence_asset_id IS NOT NULL) + (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.parent_question_id) FROM kb_question_derivation c WHERE c.child_question_id=kb_question.id)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(a.facts, '$[*]' COLUMNS( kind VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.kind', identity VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.identity', stamp TEXT PATH '$.stamp' )) f WHERE NOT ((f.kind='CONTENT' AND f.identity=CAST(kb_question.id AS CHAR) AND f.stamp=SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(kb_question.title,kb_question.stem_html,kb_question.answer_html,kb_question.analysis_html,kb_question.stem_hash,kb_question.subject,kb_question.question_type,kb_question.content_kind,kb_question.difficulty,kb_question.creation_kind,kb_question.source_note,kb_question.layout_mode,kb_question.unit_kind,kb_question.pagination_mode,kb_question.layout_note,kb_question.item_count,kb_question.has_image) AS CHAR),256)) OR (f.kind='EVIDENCE_ASSET' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN kb_asset a ON a.asset_id=qs.evidence_asset_id WHERE qs.question_id=kb_question.id AND CAST(a.asset_id AS CHAR)=f.identity AND CAST(JSON_ARRAY(a.status,a.sha256,a.file_size) AS CHAR)=f.stamp)) OR (f.kind='KP' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_question_kp qk JOIN kb_kp k ON k.id=qk.kp_id WHERE qk.question_id=kb_question.id AND CAST(k.id AS CHAR)=f.identity AND CAST(JSON_ARRAY(k.row_version,k.subject) AS CHAR)=f.stamp)) OR (f.kind='OUTLINE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_question_kp qk JOIN kb_kp_outline ko ON ko.kp_id=qk.kp_id JOIN kb_outline o ON o.id=ko.outline_id WHERE qk.question_id=kb_question.id AND CAST(o.id AS CHAR)=f.identity AND CAST(JSON_ARRAY(o.row_version,o.status,o.subject,o.catalog_kind) AS CHAR)=f.stamp)) OR (f.kind='NODE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_question_kp qk JOIN kb_outline_node_kp nk ON nk.kp_id=qk.kp_id JOIN kb_outline_node n ON n.id=nk.node_id WHERE qk.question_id=kb_question.id AND CONCAT(nk.kp_id,':',n.id)=f.identity AND CAST(JSON_ARRAY(n.row_version,n.outline_id) AS CHAR)=f.stamp)) OR (f.kind='SOURCE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN kb_source s ON s.id=qs.source_id WHERE qs.question_id=kb_question.id AND CAST(s.id AS CHAR)=f.identity AND CAST(JSON_ARRAY(s.row_version,s.source_kind) AS CHAR)=f.stamp)) OR (f.kind='OCCURRENCE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_question_source qs WHERE qs.question_id=kb_question.id AND CAST(qs.id AS CHAR)=f.identity AND CAST(JSON_ARRAY(qs.row_version,qs.source_id,qs.match_status,qs.matched_stem_hash) AS CHAR)=f.stamp)) OR (f.kind='ASSET' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_question_asset qa JOIN kb_asset a ON a.asset_id=qa.asset_id WHERE qa.question_id=kb_question.id AND CAST(a.asset_id AS CHAR)=f.identity AND CAST(JSON_ARRAY(a.status,a.sha256,a.file_size) AS CHAR)=f.stamp)) OR (f.kind='SOURCE_ASSET' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN kb_source_asset sa ON sa.source_id=qs.source_id JOIN kb_asset a ON a.asset_id=sa.asset_id WHERE qs.question_id=kb_question.id AND CONCAT(sa.source_id,':',a.asset_id)=f.identity AND CAST(JSON_ARRAY(a.status,a.sha256,a.file_size,sa.role) AS CHAR)=f.stamp)) OR (f.kind='PARENT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_question_derivation d JOIN kb_question p ON p.id=d.parent_question_id WHERE d.child_question_id=kb_question.id AND CAST(p.id AS CHAR)=f.identity AND SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(p.title,p.stem_html,p.answer_html,p.analysis_html,p.subject,p.question_type,p.content_kind,p.creation_kind,p.source_note,p.layout_mode,p.unit_kind,p.pagination_mode,p.layout_note,d.is_primary,d.operation,d.change_note,d.preserved_note) AS CHAR),256)=f.stamp)))))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_derivation WHERE child_question_id=#{questionId} AND parent_question_id=#{parentId} AND is_primary=1 AND COALESCE(operation,'')!='' AND COALESCE(change_note,'')!='' AND COALESCE(preserved_note,'')!=''
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_import_identity WHERE question_id=#{questionId} AND client_key=#{clientKey} AND create_by=#{createBy} AND request_fingerprint=#{requestFingerprint}

SELECT id,question_id questionId,source_id sourceId,question_no questionNo,page_from pageFrom, match_status matchStatus,matched_stem_hash matchedStemHash,evidence_asset_id evidenceAssetId,row_version rowVersion FROM kb_question_source WHERE question_id=#{questionId} AND source_id=#{sourceId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 2
